title: BullyBall
description:
It's only about you, bow and infinity.

BullyBall is a VR shooting range game, where your only aim is to shot balls and your only tool is a bow. Though balls are smart enough to constantly keep you in tension, so you need a strong arm to reciprocate. Be flexible in your tactics and reach the top of the Leaderboard!

Key features:
• Your thrusted Bow that you can't get rid of

• Endless Arrows with no reload

• Enemies have 8 different base behaviors without any limitations of how they can be combined. Discover all the impossible enemies you can think about and can't get through...

• Endless waves of enemies, which are evolutionary evolving based on how you play

• , and just a few HP to check if you're ambitious enough to stand against infinity
description_short: How long can you stand against evolution itself? Grab the bow, shot'em all. As long as you can. But whatever your strategy is - it can't withstand in a skirmish against endlessly evolving sets of balls. Can't it?
